title: I love this butter keeper
text: I love this butter keeper. I love this butter keeper.  I have a round one but love the rectangle shape.  The only issue I have with it, is the fact that it doesn't hold a whole block of butter.  It will hold the half blocks.  Be sure to change the water as often as it say.  It does keep the butter fresh and soft.

product_metadata.title: Butter Bay American Made Butter Keeper Butter Dish, Made in USA, Oatmeal
features: Butter Bay's unique design means loading a cube of unwrapped butter with no mess
Enjoy soft, spreadable butter anytime, without refrigeration
Holds one stick of butter (1/2 cup). SEE INSTRUCTIONAL VIDEO FOR LOADING INSTRUCTIONS.
Just add 1/4 - 1/3 cup cold water to the basin (and change the water every 3 - 4 days) to keep butter soft and spreadable
Dishwasher safe, Lead and Cadmium Free
description: Using a centuries-old French crock method, Butter Bay keeps butter soft and spreadable anytime, without refrigeration. A cube of butter fits perfectly inside, and Butter Bay's air-tight water seal maintains butter's fresh flavor for weeks. Just add 1/4 - 1/3 cup cold water to the basin (and change the water every 3 - 4 days) to keep butter soft and spreadable. Each Butter Bay is made using the slip-cast method, finished by hand, and kiln-fired in a factory that was built 114 years ago.
